summary: Backend + frontend testing for case studies (public list/detail, admin CRUD, sitemap, share buttons, filters, admin manager). All 10 pytest tests passed; UI E2E flows verified (6 seeded items, SEO filter shows 1, share buttons LinkedIn/WhatsApp/X/Copy render with correct hrefs, admin create+delete round-trip works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines; consider splitting routers (auth, leads, case-studies, blog, sitemap, settings) into modules for maintainability.

Admin update endpoint uses payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True) but CaseStudyInput has non-nullable str fields with '' defaults, so partial updates from the admin UI actually overwrite fields not shown in the form. Consider making update input a separate optional-field model.
Delete button in CaseStudyManager uses window.confirm (browser dialog); a shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with the rest of the admin UX.

Frontend data-testid naming diverges slightly from the review spec (uses 'case-study-card-<slug>' and 'case-filter-<lowercase>' instead of 'case-card-<slug>' / 'cs-filter-SEO'). Works fine functionally but worth aligning docs/tests.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; test cases and UI test row (TEST UI Case <ts>) were created and cleaned up (deleted) at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend/tests/test_case_studies.py covers public list+detail, auth guard, admin CRUD, duplicate slug 409, and sitemap inclusion. UI testids to know: case-manager-toggle, case-new, case-field-title, case-field-metric, case-save, case-row-<slug>, case-delete-<slug>, case-filter-<lowercase>, case-study-card-<slug>, case-share, share-linkedin/whatsapp/x/copy.
